text: How much can you borrow against your gold?
First, the net weight: 92 grams of 22-karat gold.
At ₹10,000 a gram (illustrative), it is worth ₹9,20,000.
RBI caps loan-to-value (LTV): 85% up to ₹2.5 lakh, 80% up to ₹5 lakh, 75% above.
So the most this gold can raise is ₹6,90,000.
Priya needs only ₹2,00,000 — the 85% tier, far below its cap.
The LTV must stay within the cap for the whole loan.
If the gold price falls: repay part, or add gold.
Bullet loans count the interest due, too.
